title: The Mongols Arrive - Megérkeznek a tatárok
grammar: Verbs of warning and approach: közeledik, figyelmeztet, betör

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe the approaching Mongol threat in the 1230s and Julianus barát's mission.
I can explain why King IV. Béla settled the fleeing Cumans in Hungary.
I can use verbs of warning and approach (figyelmeztet, közeledik, betör).
I can discuss how the Hungarian nobility reacted to the impending danger.
